_doc: D3c (MIGRATION-PLAN §3r): the Reminders copy. Two data nodes change; Stamp Reminded batches `independently` (Q18). The hourly schedule stays; a declared temporary webhook trigger (Q13) feeds Load Config for drills and is removed before any swap.
name: MIG COPY — Reminders

binaryMode.ruling: MIGRATION-PLAN §3r settings-parity (O1, 2026-10-22): the public API ignores binaryMode on create and update; every reader at the running build's source tag treats an absent binaryMode as "separate"

Find Due Appointments.query: SELECT @@shape(appointments)@@ FROM salon.appointments WHERE status = 'booked' AND NOT reminded AND start_utc > $1::timestamptz AND start_utc <= $2::timestamptz ORDER BY created_at, id

Stamp Reminded.query: UPDATE salon.appointments SET reminder_sent = $2::timestamptz, reminded = true WHERE id = $1 RETURNING @@shape(appointments)@@
